articles.title: Senate Dems should accept the victory they won on Trump's crypto limits: White House
articles.snippet: U.S. Senate Democrats got President Donald Trump to accept potential limits on his lucrative crypto dealings, but they say the Clarity Act's restrictions aren't enough.

articles.title: Crypto market maker B2C2 held sale talks with multiple potential buyers
articles.snippet: The SBI-owned crypto trading firm is said to have attracted takeover interest from a number of suitors over the past 18 months, but valuation has been a sticking point.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Is the AI-to-crypto rotation underway?
